Per your rule against guesswork, those channel modes should either omit `frequency_min_thz` or the pool should include each channel frequency. I also did not add separate **SFF-8402** or **25G Ethernet** / **24.33** / **-200.0** modes so every listed atom is consumed—say if you want full atom coverage with additional modes.
